name: Balance
description: Traverse a narrow surface or avoid falling.

name: Tumble Through
description: Evade an enemy by tumbling through their space or any space they threaten.

name: Maneuver in Flight
description: Attempting a difficult maneuver while flying.

name: Squeeze
description: Contorting to squeeze through a space so small one can barely fit through.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall Knowledge about arcane theories; magic traditions; creatures of arcane significance (like constructs, beasts, and elementals); and the Astral Plane, Elemental Planes, and the Netherworld.

name: Borrow an Arcane Spell
description: Prepare a spell from another spellcaster's spellbook or collection of spells.

name: Decipher Writing
description: Decipher a script about arcane theories or spells.

name: Identify Magic
description: Identify a spell from the arcane tradition.

name: Learn a Spell
description: Learn a new spell from the arcane tradition.

name: Climb
description: Climb up, down or across an incline, wall or other obstacle.

name: Force Open
description: Forcefully open a door, window, container or heavy gate using a tool or one's body.

name: Grapple
description: Grab hold of a creature.

name: High Jump
description: Jump vertically as high as possible after a short run up.

name: Long Jump
description: Jump horizontally as far as possible after a short run.

name: Reposition
description: Bodily move another creature or object around.

name: Shove
description: Push a creature away.

name: Swim
description: Swim through a body of water.

name: Trip
description: Knock a creature prone.

name: Disarm
description: Knock a weapon from a creature's grasp.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall Knowledge about alchemical reactions, the value of items, engineering, unusual materials, and alchemical or mechanical creatures, such as constructs.

name: Repair
description: Fix a broken item.

name: Craft
description: Craft an item.

name: Earn Income
description: Earn income by crafting or repairing items and goods for the market.

name: Identify Alchemy
description: Identify alchemical items and reagents.

name: Create a Diversion
description: Distract a creature and draw its attention elsewhere.

name: Feint
description: Perform a feint in combat to leave an opponent off-guard.

name: Impersonate
description: Create a disguise to pass as someone else.

name: Lie
description: Tell a lie to deceive someone.

name: Gather Information
description: Canvass local markets, taverns, and gathering places in an attempt to learn about a creature, individual or topic.

name: Make an Impression
description: Seek to make a good impression on someone to make them temporarily agreeable.

name: Request
description: Make a request of a creature.

name: Coerce
description: Threaten a creature into doing what you want.

name: Demoralize
description: Shake an enemy's resolve and frighten them.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Use knowledge of a specific topic to recall lore.

name: Earn Income
description: Earn income by using knowledge of a specific topic to practice a trade.

name: Administer First Aid
description: Administer first aid to a creature that is dying or bleeding.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall knowledge about diseases, injuries, poisons, and other ailments.

name: Treat Disease
description: Care for and attempt to cure a diseased creature.

name: Treat Poison
description: Care for and attempt to cure a poisoned creature.

name: Treat Wounds
description: Care for and heal a wounded creature.

name: Command an Animal
description: Issue a command to an animal and have it obey.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall knowledge about fauna, flora, geography, weather, the environment, creatures of natural origin (like animals, beasts, fey, and plants), the First World, and the Elemental Planes.

name: Identify Magic
description: Identify a spell from the primal tradition.

name: Learn a Spell
description: Learn a new spell from the primal tradition.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall knowledge about ancient mysteries; obscure philosophies; creatures of occult significance (like aberrations, spirits, and oozes); and esoteric planes like the Astral Plane, Creation's Forge, the Ethereal Plane, the Netherworld, and the Void.

name: Decipher Writing
description: Decipher Writing on occult topics, including complex metaphysical systems, syncretic principles, obscure philosophies, and incoherent ramblings.

name: Identify Magic
description: Identify a spell from the occult tradition.

name: Learn a Spell
description: Learn a new spell from the occult tradition.

name: Perform
description: Make a brief performance such as one song, a quick dance, or a few jokes.

name: Earn Income
description: Stage a performance to earn money.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall knowledge about divine agents, the finer points of theology, obscure myths regarding a faith, and creatures of religious significance (like celestials, fiends, and undead), Creation's Forge, the Void, and the Outer Sphere.

name: Decipher Writing
description: Decipher Writing of a religious nature, including allegories, homilies, and proverbs.

name: Identify Magic
description: Identify a spell from the divine tradition.

name: Learn a Spell
description: Learn a new spell from the divine tradition.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Recall knowledge about local history, important personalities, legal institutions, societal structure, and humanoid cultures. The GM might allow Society to apply to other creatures that are major elements of society in your region, such as the draconic nobility in a kingdom of humans ruled by dragons.

name: Subsist
description: Subsist in a settlement by finding shelter, scrounging, or begging for food.

name: Create Forgery
description: Create a forgery of a document or object.

name: Decipher Writing
description: Decipher Writing that's a coded message, text written in an incomplete or archaic form, or in some cases, text in a language you don't know.

name: Conceal an Object
description: Hide a small object to avoid discovery when searched.

name: Hide
description: Hide behind cover or blend deeper into concealment.

name: Sneak
description: Slowly move silently or stay hidden while moving.

name: Sense Direction
description: Use knowledge of the natural world and survival experience to navigate.

name: Subsist
description: Subsist in the wild by foraging for food and building shelter.

name: Cover Tracks
description: Hide any trace of passage while on the move.

name: Track
description: Follow tracks left by a creature or vehicle.

name: Palm an Object
description: Secretly pick up a small, unattended object.

name: Steal
description: Secretly steal a small object from a creature.

name: Disable a Device
description: Disarm a trap or disable a complex device.

name: Pick a Lock
description: Open a lock without a key.
